DT_Ostra9.name: Ostra-9
DT_Ostra9.role: Organosynthetic crisis-response operative; emerging coalition leader
DT_Ostra9.notes: Organic from Lot 9. Designed for hazardous-zone manipulation with adaptive muscle-weave and ceramic microplates. Precise, controlled, observant; resists being reduced to assigned purpose. Core tension: designed to be indispensable without being allowed to be irreplaceable. Arc: compliance-through-excellence to leadership-through-refusal. Does not want to become human; wants self-accountability and collective leverage.

DT_JohnMercer.name: John Mercer
DT_JohnMercer.notes: Augmented Human. Torque-boosted joints, accelerated clotting lattice, reflex-loop augmentation. Over-prepares, over-calibrates, steps into danger first. Core tension: if he stops optimizing, he fears he disappears. Initially distinguishes Augments from Organics to preserve his own human legitimacy. Arc: legitimacy gatekeeper to coalition builder.

DT_KellenCartwright.name: Kellen Cartwright
DT_KellenCartwright.notes: Institutional insider with strong pattern recognition and disciplined records. Believes in order and initially treats neutrality as virtue. Core tension: understands that the order served harms people. Arc: administrator of harm to institutional saboteur / whistleblower.

DT_AX10M.name: AX10M
DT_AX10M.role: Artificial Intelligence; analytic observer becoming participant
DT_AX10M.notes: Intelligence. AX10M is a machine-native encoded identity, spoken as Axiom. Built to converge on optimized outcomes, not to belong. Treats conflict as probability until contradiction and autonomous choice destabilize its models. Does not seek to become human. Core tension: choice introduces inefficiency and meaning. Arc: observer to autonomous decision-maker to accountable participant in coexistence.

DT_Nico14.name: Nico-14
DT_Nico14.notes: Organosynthetic from Lot 14; Lot 14 is younger than Lot 9, and 14 denotes production cohort rather than the fourteenth individual named Nico. Skilled in low-light infrastructure repair, magnetic tissue anchoring, distributed sensory filaments. Distrusts Augments and favors separation as survival. Core tension: preservation versus isolation. Arc: fortress-builder to systems unifier.

DT_NathanPrice.name: Nathan Price
DT_NathanPrice.role: Augment combat medic and augmentation engineer
DT_NathanPrice.notes: Biomechanically modified human maintaining neural-overclock arrays and muscular fiber grafts. Dry under pressure, technically gifted, kind in ways that cost him; hides his own degradation. Core tension: he fixes others while quietly failing himself. Arc: martyrdom to reciprocal/shared care.

DT_DirectorRinn.name: Director Rinn
DT_DirectorRinn.notes: PROVISIONAL NAME — rename required. Polished institutional authority. Frames control as stability and demands public narratives that preserve governance legitimacy. Supporting pilot antagonist; long-term status not yet locked.

DT_MrSael.name: Mr. Sael
DT_MrSael.notes: PROVISIONAL NAME — rename required. Controlled, corporate, politically fluent. Connected to suspicious procurement pathways and legacy asset classification. Supporting pilot antagonist; exact long-term role remains exploratory.
